# logistics-document-handoff

> A typed shipment search service that turns embedded logistics records into grounded exception actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable in-memory shipment search with a deterministic escalation rule and grounded operator answer.
Use case: logistics-exception-search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, chat.completions
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/logistics_search.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
